verdict.rationale: Zero documents self-hosting as a core capability, which lets a user run the app on infrastructure they choose and so decide where Zero's own data lives. However, there is no region or residency selector for the hosted service. The repo also notes that user emails are stored in Durable Objects and an R2 bucket, with no documented way to control the region of that storage. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for the hosted offering, documentation of where hosted data lives, region configuration for the Durable Object/R2 storage in self-hosted deployments, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
